Assuming potential x and y at the top junctions A and B respectively and zero potential at lower junctions.

At the junction A applying KCL,

11x - 6y = 144 ......(1)

At the junction B applying KCL,

i4 + i5 = 0



= 0

Solving (1) and (2)

x = 24 V

The charge on the capacitor, q = CV
